title: Page 344
transc:
Washington Jan 25 / 65
G. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Henrietta for polker lawman polking abbott Zebra have the
Susquehanna ready to take Jupiter to Cape fear whelp
morning provided the Aaron does not return in time
if the latter vessel has not gone stop her
as the Saugus has just arrived off vernon looked
out youth burton not is yet got Mount and
T. T. Eckert


City Point Jan. 25 / 65
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Imogene for meriden I shall leave here whelp
toby absent several days unity I wish you
to return to your silver sligo field see
that encase of tarquinty you wilby on hand
to take charge of oysters opera thing from
here unity it will answer if you stair
tup in the morning yoke Jersey thats all
S. H. Beckwith


City Point Jan 26 / 65
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Elizabeth harsh pledge I N Palmer fortune unity 
all asked for bayou has been ordered ditto
not lesson plague purple spit will wick to
you pedlar prepare accordingly youth Juno lamp love 
S. H. Beckwith
